_comment: Per-workload object-type apply toggles for SharePoint. Loaded automatically by Restore-M365TenantConfig when scope.workloadSwitches.SharePoint = true and restore.config.json does not contain an inline scope.workloadObjectTypes.SharePoint block. Schema: flat { name: bool } or wrapped { objectTypes: { name: bool } }. SharePoint restore is export-first today: none of these flags drive write-back yet; they list what we have on disk so admins can pre-select scope as apply coverage grows. App-only (cert) auth uses PnP for items marked PnP; pure SPO items (Get-SPO* cmdlets) require an interactive Connect-SPOService and will be skipped under app-only.
